died.name: Robert Bruce of Kinnaird
died.desc: Moderator of the General Assembly of the Church of Scotland
died.last_words: Now, God be with you, my dear children; I have breakfasted with you, and shall sup with my Lord Jesus Christ this night.

died.name: Henri de La Tour d'Auvergne, Viscount of Turenne
died.cause: struck by a cannonball at the Battle of Salzbach
died.last_words: I did not mean to be killed today.

died.name: William Lowndes Yancey
died.desc: Confederate journalist, politician, orator and diplomat

died.name: George Taylor
died.cause: The tunnel watchman for the Louisville and Nashville Railroad was killed by a falling cow while working at a south tunnel near Gallatin, Tennessee. An investigation confirmed that the cow was standing on top of the tunnel when it fell off the edge, landing on the watchman, killing him instantly. The cow was also killed from the fall.

died.name: Gustav Kobbé
died.cause: The 61-year-old author and music critic was sailing in Great South Bay, New York, when he noticed a low-flying seaplane heading toward him. Kobbé attempted to get into the water, but the plane crashed into the mast of Kobbé's boat, splitting his head open.

died.name: Ferruccio Busoni
died.last_words: Dear Gerda, I thank you for every day we have been together.

died.name: Gertrude Stein
died.cause: addressing her life partner Alice B. Toklas
died.last_words: What is the answer? In that case, what is the question?

died.name: Kevin Carter
died.cause: in his suicide note, before killing himself from carbon monoxide poisoning
died.last_words: I'm really, really sorry. The pain of life overrides the joy to the point that joy does not exist... depressed... without phone... money for rent... money for child support... money for debts... money!!!... I am haunted by the vivid memories of killings & corpses & anger & pain... of starving or wounded children, of trigger-happy madmen, often police, of killer executioners... I have gone to join Ken if I am that lucky.

born.name: Charlotte Corday
born.last_words: One man have I slain to save a hundred thousand.

born.name: Thomas Campbell
born.last_words: When I think of the existence which shall commence when the stone is laid over my head, how can literary fame appear to me, to any one, but as nothing? I believe, when I am gone, justice will be done to me in this way - that I was a pure writer. It is an inexpressible comfort, at my time of life, to be able to look back and feel that I have not written one line against religion or virtue.
